title: Central Authority Protection of Consumers Rights

content.scenario: The Central Authority is required to protect, promote and enforce the rights of consumers as a class, and prevent violation of consumers rights under this Act.
content.outcome: The Central Authority shall protect, promote and enforce the rights of consumers as a class, and prevent violation of consumers rights under this Act.

user_queries: What is the role of the Central Authority in protecting consumers rights?
How does the Central Authority promote and enforce the rights of consumers?
What are the consequences of violating consumers rights?
